breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions for the time integration method: 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'IMEX Euler... OR use Strang splitting...'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified this conflict, discarded the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' method, and chose one of the valid options ('IMEX Euler') from the remaining instruction, thereby successfully resolving the ambiguity.
